title: FeedbackEntry
description: One reviewer comment extracted and classified by feedback_parser

reviewer.description: Reviewer name/role as found in file or provided by user

source_file.description: Relative path from project root, e.g. inputs/reviews/round1/smith.docx

location.description: Human-readable location in proposal, e.g. Section 1.2, para 3

original_text.description: The proposal text being commented on, if identifiable

category.description: evidence=missing citation; technical=wrong claim; structural=section/order; writing=clarity; compliance=template; style=typos; ambiguous=unclear; parse_error=file unreadable; ack=positive-only

comment_type.description: How this comment was recorded in the source file

candidates.description: For category=ambiguous only: the two possible categories

routed_to.description: Target agent name, e.g. literature_searcher, feedback_applier, compliance_checker

resolution.description: Human-readable summary of how it was addressed

round_closed.description: Round number in which this entry was closed

dedupe_key.description: Stable hash for cross-round deduplication: reviewer+location+topic slug
